text: The broadcast went out. You all heard it — and you heard each other. Tell the crew what you heard.
I heard Jed find the old man in it. Forestry. Chalk dust. I didn't know the song had a father in it. Then I listened to my own take again — it was all rope. Both are true.
Nova lit the fish that got away. I was still holding the debt. She turned the whole sea into a city of lights. I wanted to be mad. I was just glad.
Ruth sang the last line like a verdict. I sang it like a memory. She's right, and I'm right — the song holds all of it.
Elias's room. You could hear the crew pulling on the rope. I build cities of light, but I don't build rooms. I wanted that weight.
First night we walked around the song. Tonight we stand in it.
